title: 4 Day Luxury Tanzania Safari
overview: A short, comfortable northern-circuit safari for travellers who want premium lodges and the Serengeti without a long itinerary. You game-drive Tarangire among elephants and baobabs, spend a night in the Serengeti, then fly back to Arusha.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Arusha
body: We meet you at Kilimanjaro or Arusha airport and take you to a luxury hotel in Arusha. In the evening your guide runs a safari briefing.

itinerary.title: Tarangire National Park
body: A full day of game driving through Tarangire, known for large elephant herds, baobab groves and the Tarangire River. Lunch is a picnic in the park.

itinerary.title: Serengeti National Park
body: Drive through the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and descend to the plains. An afternoon game drive around Seronera looks for lions, leopards and cheetahs.

itinerary.title: Final game drive and flight to Arusha
body: A last early drive in the central Serengeti, then a scheduled flight back to Arusha for your onward travel.

title: 5 Day Luxury Wildebeest Migration Safari (Serengeti Focus)
overview: Five days built around the Serengeti and the Great Migration, with three nights inside the park so your guide can follow the herds. The trip starts in Tarangire and finishes with a morning in Ngorongoro Crater.

itinerary.title: Arrival and transfer to Tarangire
body: After airport pickup you drive through Maasai country to Tarangire for an afternoon game drive along the river among elephant herds and baobabs.

itinerary.title: Central Serengeti
body: Cross the Ngorongoro Conservation Area to the Serengeti and start the Seronera game drive, a stronghold for resident big cats.

itinerary.title: Full-day migration safari
body: Your guide positions the vehicle wherever the herds are, whether river crossings, open plains or northern routes, with chances to see lions, cheetahs and hyenas.

itinerary.title: Extended Serengeti exploration
body: A flexible day across kopjes, river valleys and grassland, following wildlife movements.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater and departure
body: After an early breakfast you descend into the crater for a half-day game drive, then transfer to Arusha or Kilimanjaro airport after lunch.

title: 7 Day Luxury Big Five & Wildebeest Migration Safari
overview: A full northern-circuit safari in luxury lodges, covering Tarangire, three nights in the Serengeti, Ngorongoro Crater and Lake Manyara. Timed for the Big Five and the migration herds.

body: Airport pickup, hotel transfer and an evening briefing with your guide.

itinerary.title: Tarangire National Park
body: A full day among elephants and baobabs with a picnic lunch in the park.

itinerary.title: Into the Serengeti
body: Travel via the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. The first game drive concentrates on predators and migration herds.

itinerary.title: Full-day Serengeti safari
body: A flexible day over plains, river valleys and kopjes to maximise sightings.

itinerary.title: Serengeti to Ngorongoro
body: A morning game drive, then on to a crater-rim lodge in time for sunset over the caldera.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater and Lake Manyara
body: Half a day on the crater floor, a picnic lunch, then the drive to Lake Manyara.

itinerary.title: Lake Manyara and return to Arusha
body: A morning game drive for flamingos, elephants and tree-climbing lions, then transfer to Arusha for your flight.

title: 6 Day Luxury Great Migration River Crossing Safari (Northern Serengeti)
overview: Stay two nights in the northern Serengeti close to the Mara River crossing points, the best place to see the migration from July to October. The route starts at Lake Manyara and ends in Ngorongoro Crater.
highlights: Two nights near the Mara River

itinerary.title: Lake Manyara National Park
body: Airport pickup, then an afternoon game drive for flamingos, elephants and tree-climbing lions.

itinerary.title: Journey to the northern Serengeti
body: A long scenic drive through the Ngorongoro highlands and the central Serengeti into the northern migration zone.

itinerary.title: Mara River crossing safari
body: A full day following the herds along the Mara River, positioned near active crossing points.

itinerary.title: More migration action
body: A second full day at the northern hotspots for more chances to see crossings and predators.

itinerary.title: Serengeti to the Ngorongoro rim
body: A last morning game drive, then the drive south to a crater-rim lodge for sunset over the caldera.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater and departure
body: Half a day on the crater floor for rhinos, lions, elephants and flamingos, then a picnic lunch and transfer to the airport.

itinerary.title: Tarangire National Park
body: Drive from Arusha for an afternoon game drive for elephants and other wildlife along the Tarangire River.

itinerary.title: Central Serengeti
body: Enter via Naabi Hill Gate and game-drive Seronera, a hub for predators and migrating herds.

itinerary.title: Northern Serengeti
body: Head north to the Mara River, where your guide tracks herd movements and crossing activity.

itinerary.title: Back to Central Serengeti
body: Spend the morning on migration viewing in the north, then drive south with game viewing along the way.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater
body: Descend about 600 metres for a full crater game drive with a picnic lunch, then return to Arusha.

title: 10 Day Mount Kilimanjaro Climb via Lemosho Route (Daylight Summit)
overview: A slow, scenic Lemosho ascent from the west with extra acclimatisation days and a daylight summit push to Uhuru Peak. The long schedule raises summit success rates.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tanzania
body: Arrive at Kilimanjaro airport, transfer to Arusha and meet your guide for a briefing and gear check.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Londorossi Gate and Big Tree Camp
body: Drive to the western gate, register, and walk through humid rainforest to camp.

itinerary.title: Big Tree Camp to Shira 1 Camp
body: Climb out of the forest into open moorland.

itinerary.title: Shira 1 to Shira 2 Camp
body: A gentle crossing of the Shira Plateau with views of Mount Meru.

itinerary.title: Shira 2 to Moir Camp
body: Move to a quieter area with optional ridge walks for acclimatisation.

itinerary.title: Moir Camp to Barranco Camp via Lava Tower
body: Climb to Lava Tower, then descend into the Barranco Valley to sleep lower.

itinerary.title: Barranco to Karanga Camp
body: Climb the Barranco Wall, then cross ridges and valleys.

itinerary.title: Karanga to Barafu Camp
body: Walk through alpine desert to base camp and rest early. An optional upgrade stays at Kosovo Camp.

itinerary.title: Summit day: Uhuru Peak
body: Start at dawn, climb in daylight to the roof of Africa, then descend to Barafu.

itinerary.title: Barafu to Mweka Camp
body: Descend through alpine desert and moorland into forest.

itinerary.title: Mweka Camp to Mweka Gate
body: Walk down through the rainforest, collect your summit certificate and return to Arusha for a celebration dinner.

title: 10 Day Mount Kilimanjaro Climb via Northern Circuit (Daylight Summit)
overview: The Northern Circuit is Kilimanjaro's longest and most gradual route, looping around the quiet northern slopes. It suits climbers who want the best acclimatisation and the fewest crowds.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tanzania
body: Arrive at Kilimanjaro airport, transfer to Arusha and meet your guide for a briefing and gear check.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Londorossi Gate and Big Tree Camp

itinerary.title: Shira 1 to Shira 2 Camp

itinerary.title: Shira 2 to Moir Camp
body: Move to a quieter area with optional ridge walks for acclimatisation.

itinerary.title: Moir Camp to Buffalo Camp
body: A quiet northern section with views toward Kenya.

itinerary.title: Buffalo Camp to Third Cave Camp

itinerary.title: School Hut to Uhuru Peak
body: Summit in daylight, then descend to Barafu Camp to recover.

itinerary.title: Barafu to Mweka Camp
body: Descend through alpine terrain back into the forest.

itinerary.title: Mweka Camp to Mweka Gate
body: Walk down through the rainforest, collect your summit certificate and return to Arusha for a celebration dinner.

title: 1 Day Kilimanjaro Day Hike via Lemosho Route
overview: A one-day walk on the western side of Kilimanjaro for people who want the mountain without a multi-day climb. You hike from Londorossi Gate through montane forest to the Shira Plateau at about 3,600 m.

itinerary.title: Londorossi Gate to the Shira Plateau
body: Early pickup from Arusha or Moshi (2.5 to 3.5 hours), breakfast, then a demanding hike through forest to the plateau. Stop for lunch there or continue toward Shira 1 Camp and Lion Gorge, then return to the gate and transfer back.
